v.Name: Open House
v.TargetX_Eventsb__Description__c:
Spend the day exploring every corner of Beacon College and get an inside look at our campus, community, and approach to college. 

Our Open House features:
• Welcome from campus leadership
• Guided campus tour with admissions staff and student ambassadors
• Interactive sessions covering academics, college readiness, careers, and the student experience
• Lunch with current Beacon students to learn more about the clubs, activities, and experiences that interest you
• Campus resource fair
• Opportunities for personal meetings with admissions and/or financial aid

Throughout the day, you’ll have the chance to ask questions, connect with members of the Beacon community, and experience campus firsthand. It’s an opportunity to get a closer look at what makes Beacon unique and see what your college experience could look like here. Perfect for students and families looking for a comprehensive introduction to Beacon College!

If you have trouble registering online for this event, please email us at admissions@beaconcollege.edu for assistance.
